title: Wall Street Hits Record High: S&P 500 +1.79% to 7,736.52, DJIA +1.34% to 54,085.88
summary: US stocks surged to record highs on Aug 4 as strong earnings and easing trade tensions drove broad gains. S&P 500 closed at 7,736.52 (+1.79%), Dow Jones at 54,085.88 (+1.34%), Nasdaq Composite at 25,057.52 (+1.67%). Tech and AI-linked names led the advance.
why: US market at all-time high strengthens bull case for tech holdings; rising indices support higher covered-call strike selection and lower put risk.

title: A股8月4日收盘：创业板指大涨5.64%至3488.97点，算力产业链全线爆发
summary: 8月4日A股三大指数集体收涨，创业板指飙涨5.64%至3,488.97点，全市场超3600只个股上涨，总成交额逾2.2万亿元。通信设备板块涨10.74%、光芯片涨10.26%、CPO概念涨6.90%、PCB概念涨5.92%，算力产业链全面爆发。
why: A股7月算力配置行情延续，创业板连续大涨确认上升势头稳固；关注持仓算力链相关个股及AI供应商股价动态。

title: 港股8月4日：恒指微跌0.49%，汽车股承压，光通信概念逆势走强
summary: 8月4日港股恒生指数收跌0.49%，报25,310点，恒生科技指数跌0.17%。汽车板块受拖累，光通信概念股逆势上涨。南向资金净买入约35亿港元。
why: 港股整体稳定，南向资金持续流入支撑。持仓港股第三方(3690/0700/9988)需关注汽车板块拖累效应。

title: Amazon Crosses $3 Trillion Market Cap; Bezos Files to Sell $4.07B in Shares
summary: Amazon crossed the $3 trillion market capitalization milestone on Aug 4, joining Apple, Nvidia, and Microsoft in that exclusive club. Jeff Bezos simultaneously filed to sell approximately $4.07 billion worth of Amazon shares, sending shares lower after the filing.
why: Amazon joining $3T club confirms continued mega-cap strength; Bezos sale filing worth watching for sentiment impact on AMZN and tech sector broadly.

title: Palantir Q2 2026 Actual Results: Revenue $1.94B (+93% YoY), EPS $0.41, Full-Year Guidance Raised; Stock +26%
summary: Palantir (PLTR) reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.94 billion, up 93% year-over-year, crushing the $1.55B consensus estimate. Adjusted EPS of $0.41 beat the $0.29 consensus. US commercial revenue surged 152% YoY to $601M driven by AIP platform adoption. Company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $7.72-7.76B (prior: $7.46-7.54B). Stock surged 26% in after-hours trading on Aug 3.
why: 直接持仓PLTR；Q2远超预期确认了AIP商业化加速逸，展望指引上调是期权正向强信号。评估当前持仓目标价及 covered call 行权价是否需要上调。

title: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8-Max: 2.4T-Parameter MoE Model Claims Top AI Benchmarks; BABA HK +7%
summary: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4 trillion parameter mixture-of-experts model, claiming state-of-the-art performance on major AI benchmarks, outperforming GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro on coding and reasoning tasks. The model is available open-source. BABA HK shares (9988.HK) rose 7% on the news on Aug 3.
why: 持仓阿里巴巴(9988)，模型落地确认AI产品竞争力；关注阿里云AI API收入加速是否在Q3业绩中得到印证。

title: Circle (CRCL) Downgraded by Morgan Stanley to Underweight; PT Slashed to $38 from $106
summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Circle Internet (CRCL) to Underweight from Equal Weight, cutting the price target to $38 from $106, citing rising competition in the stablecoin market and margin pressure from the Coinbase revenue-sharing arrangement. Circle also reported Q2 2026 earnings on Aug 3. Shares fell sharply after the downgrade.
why: 持仓CRCL相关稳定币监管走势需关注；Morgan Stanley大幅下调影响市场情绪，将推高隐含波动率和期权定价。
